rounds.text: Glottis Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its sector peers, with a P/E ratio of 16.44x compared to the benchmark of 18.68x and a P/B ratio of 2.21x against the sector’s 2.55x [E6, E7]. This valuation gap is fundamentally unjustified given the company’s superior operational efficiency, evidenced by an ROA of 10.27% which vastly outperforms the sector benchmark of 3.68% [E8]. The long-term growth trajectory remains robust, highlighted by a 235% compounded sales growth over five years and a 180% CAGR in profit growth over the same period [E14, E50]. Recent signals from the scanX engine confirm that earnings growth is accelerating and sales are trending upward on a quarter-over-quarter basis [E57, E58]. Conceded: [E4, E16, E60]. Despite the recent volatility in year-over-year sales, the company’s ability to maintain a valuation below sector averages while delivering high-quality asset returns suggests the market has yet to fully price in its long-term compounding potential [E1, E2, E8, E14].
